productInvariants.description: Concurrent external FMC requests are bounded by source-modeled back-pressure. Source settings define 10 concurrent connections.
Credentialed live tests are present or implied and must remain outside default local acceptance unless explicitly enabled.
Public MCP resources and tools are externally meaningful contract surfaces.
Rate limiting behavior is a product invariant for external FMC API access. Source settings define 120 requests per minute.
FMC domain operations are modeled as read-oriented external calls; auth-token POSTs are separate from domain mutation behavior.
Secret-bearing settings and credentials must remain redacted and must not be logged or exposed in model artifacts.

runtimeContracts.description: Constructs the client during runtime setup/lifespan.
Delegates registered MCP tool handlers to the tools module.
Obtains the injected client through the resources access point.
Exposes stdio and/or HTTP/SSE runtime mode selection.
Injects the runtime client into the shared resources module.
